announcement.quote: FULL CIRCLE CAPITAL CORPORATION TO MERGE

outcome_evidence.quote: BOSTON, November 3, 2016 - Great Elm Capital Corp. (NASDAQ:GECC) today announced the successful completion of the merger between GECC and Full Circle Capital Corporation

deals.notes: Merger agreement dated June 23, 2016 between Full Circle and GECC (a newco formed for the merger). Special meeting date was set for October 25, 2016 (seq=6); completion announced in the 8-K exhibit 99.1 (event date 2016-11-03, filed 2016-11-07). GECC is shown as NASDAQ-listed; the excerpts show Full Circle only as a business development company (a BDC election), with no exchange listing printed, so both_listed is null.
